description: React Native component for a sidebar menu in a food delivery app, managing user profile, notifications, and navigation links.

methods.name: SideBar
methods.description: Main functional component rendering the sidebar with user info, notification toggle, and navigation links.

methods.name: checkToken
methods.description: Checks and requests notification permissions, and sends push token to backend if enabled.

methods.name: checkTokenOnFocus
methods.description: Rechecks notification permission when app comes to foreground and enables notifications if permitted.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles toggling notification settings, requesting permissions, and opening app settings if needed.
